notes: Two destructor shards first, then (2026-10-28) the three camera helpers func_020070e8, func_020071a8 and func_020071e0 and the Vector3 destructor func_020071e0 emits. #pragma defer_codegen off puts the functions in source order: D1, D0, D2, then the helpers. D2 is deadstripped. RTTI stays on because the cartridge spells this class dCamera_c, so the emitted _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS records have retail homes and are deadstrip-data rather than homeless. The retail vtable at 0x02086f84 remains the linked copy.

The helpers keep their ROM names under C linkage because the other camera shards call them by those names. They read the real dCamera_c fields; mTargetPlayer is an s32 in the header and is cast to dActor_c * for the player's position and facing.
AngleDiff is declared short locally: func_020071a8 compares its result without sign-extending it, and the definition returns int. Banked in config/decl-agreement-baseline.json.
Not folded into d_camera.cpp: the runs are not adjacent. The opt_common_subs split that keeps 0x0200af0c..0x0200bec4 out of d_camera.cpp is unchanged.
